items.title: What does a regression cost while it stays undetected?
items.description: Grounded in this unit's refund-tool scenario: the clamping regression shipped and ran silently until a support ticket surfaced it 9 days later. Each day it stayed live, some number of refunds were affected, each one wrong by a real dollar amount. Drag 'days undetected' toward 0 and watch the cost collapse toward what a single automated test — written once, run on every future change for free — would have cost instead: effectively nothing, because it would have caught the bug before it ever shipped.

params.name: daysUndetected
params.label: Days the regression ran before being caught

items.compute: const totalCost = params.daysUndetected * params.affectedRefundsPerDay * params.costPerWrongRefund; return { totalCost };

outputs.label: Total cost of the regression while undetected
